_meta.title: ui-playing-card ship — GH #1478 (ADR-0225, proposed)
_meta.note: Two-plane decomposition per break-down-problem (components domain). Nodes = anatomy parts + ship artifacts; actions = the obligations Kim's #1478 full-scope ruling names. Build slices (one writer per file) live in the intake §7; this manifest carries the coverage + build-order truth.

nodes.label: playing-card-pips.ts — per-rank pip layout table (A + 2–10 pip grids, J/Q/K letter treatment; pure data + derivation, the avatar-initials.ts sibling-module shape)
nodes.accept: npx vitest run packages/agent-ui/components/src/controls/playing-card/playing-card.test.ts exits 0 with a table-driven assertion: pip count per rank equals the rank's numeric value for A,2..10 and J/Q/K take the letter treatment (no pip grid)

nodes.label: playing-card.ts — UIPlayingCardElement host: typed props rank/suit/faceDown (prop.enum/boolean, reflected), internals role=img + derived accessible name, :state(ready) post-first-paint flip, renders flipper/face/back parts
nodes.accept: npx vitest run packages/agent-ui/components/src/controls/playing-card/playing-card.test.ts exits 0: props reflect (rank/suit/face-down attributes), internals.role === 'img', label reads '<Rank> of <suit>' face-up and 'Face-down card' (never the rank/suit) when faceDown

nodes.label: [data-part=flipper] — the 3D rotor holding both faces (rotateY 0↔180deg keyed off [face-down])
nodes.accept: playing-card.browser.test.ts: getComputedStyle(flipper).transform changes between face-up and face-down states, and the transition property is present only under :state(ready) and absent under prefers-reduced-motion

nodes.label: [data-part=face] — the front face (indices + pip field on the light face surface)
[data-part=index] top-left corner index — rank text + suit glyph, real text
nodes.accept: playing-card.test.ts: the upper index's textContent contains the literal rank string and the suit glyph character

nodes.label: [data-part=index][data-inverted] bottom-right corner index — same content, rotated 180deg
nodes.accept: playing-card.browser.test.ts: the lower index's computed transform is a 180deg rotation and its box sits in the lower-right quadrant of the host box

nodes.label: [data-part=pips] — the center pip field rendering the rank's layout from the pips table (lower-half pips rotated, the physical-card convention)
nodes.accept: playing-card.browser.test.ts: for a sampled rank set (A, 5, 10, Q) the rendered pip/letter node count and gestalt bounding box match the table (test-the-whole-shape bar)

nodes.label: [data-part=back] — the face-down back: CSS lattice pattern inside an inset frame, no glyph, no image asset
nodes.accept: playing-card.browser.test.ts: when face-down the back part is the visible face, its computed background-image resolves to a non-none gradient lattice, and no rank/suit text is visible

nodes.label: playing-card.css — token block (--ui-playing-card-*: light face surface both schemes, red/black suit inks off flat primitives, back lattice inks) + geometry (aspect-ratio 9/14, em-keyed inline-size, [size] sm/md/lg repoint, radius/type calc off the box) + motion (flip transition, @starting-style deal entrance, reduced-motion arms)
nodes.accept: playing-card.browser.test.ts: host box width/height ratio ≈ 9/14 at every [size] tier; hearts/diamonds ink computed color differs from spades/clubs ink and both hold ≥4.5:1 contrast on the face surface in BOTH color schemes

nodes.label: playing-card.md — the component descriptor (tier: display, extends: UIElement, props/parts truthful)
nodes.accept: the standing descriptor gates (component-descriptor.test.ts + sizing/naming/styling gates) exit 0 with playing-card.md present

nodes.label: controls/index.ts barrel export (serial integration slice — the one shared-file edit)
nodes.accept: npm run check exits 0 and importing @agent-ui/components/components self-defines ui-playing-card (barrels.test.ts residency)

nodes.label: croupier factories.ts retarget — playingCardFactory tag 'ui-playing-card', applyProp = direct prop pass-through; SUIT_GLYPH/WeakMap/render() deleted
nodes.accept: npx vitest run packages/agent-ui/a2ui/src/catalog/personas/croupier/factories.test.ts exits 0: factory creates a ui-playing-card element and rank/suit/faceDown wire props land as element props; catalog.json byte-identical (git diff --exit-code on it)

nodes.label: default catalog EXCLUSION_ALLOWLIST entry 'PlayingCard' (persona-scoped content type, ADR-0225 cl.2 — drafted verbatim in the ADR)
nodes.accept: npx vitest run packages/agent-ui/a2ui/src/catalog/default/index.test.ts exits 0 (the ADR-0087 coverage gate green with the new fleet descriptor present and NO default-catalog row)

nodes.label: site surfaces — doc page, demo page, gallery/preview specimen (a real dealt-hand specimen incl. one face-down card, example-authoring law)
nodes.accept: npm run check exits 0 (check:site + site-coverage/site-canon standing gates green with the new pages)

nodes.label: playing-card.browser.test.ts — the painted-truth shard leg (faces, pips, back, flip, ramp, reduced-motion)
nodes.accept: npm run test:browser exits 0 with the file in an existing shard (never a new monolith; component-testing shard law)

actions.label: identify rank+suit at a glance from either card corner (text-readable, never color-alone — ADR-0057)
render the rank's pip layout (A + 2–10 true pip counts; J/Q/K letter treatment — court art refused)
paint hearts/diamonds red and spades/clubs black as redundant identity carriers on a face that stays light in both schemes
conceal the card value when face-down behind a real painted back pattern (no 🂠 glyph, no leak through the accessible name)
hold the bridge aspect (9/14) across the sm/md/lg size ramp, interior type/pips scaling with the box
animate a 3D flip when faceDown changes — ready-gated (no first-paint animation), fleet motion tokens, reduced-motion = instant swap
play a deal entrance when a card enters the DOM (@starting-style; reduced-motion = none; no timing props minted)
expose one accessible name ('<Rank> of <suit>' / 'Face-down card') via ElementInternals, parts presentational
carry rank/suit/faceDown as typed reflected props so CSS keys off attributes and the wire maps 1:1
an agent emitting PlayingCard through the croupier persona catalog renders ui-playing-card unchanged on the wire
the default catalog stays closed to PlayingCard — the ADR-0087 catalog-or-allowlist gate passes by allowlist, not by row
prove the painted truth (faces/pips/back/flip/ramp) in a real engine, not jsdom
clear the standing descriptor/site/barrel gates a new control drags
teach the control on the docs site with a real dealt-hand specimen

edges.why: the host imports the pip layout table to render [data-part=pips]
the CSS @scope selectors target the parts + reflected attributes the host defines
the descriptor documents the frozen prop/part surface; the driftwire gate compares it to source
the browser leg drives the shipped element
painted assertions (aspect, inks, back lattice, flip transition) read the production CSS
the barrel exports the finished module (serial integration slice)
the factory self-defines ui-playing-card via the components barrel import
the ADR-0087 coverage gate derives the fleet type set from descriptors — the allowlist entry must land with/after the descriptor or the gate goes red
doc/demo/gallery pages import the defined element
